import sys
import logging
from dd4hep.simulation import (
    DD4hepSimulation,
    CommandLine,
    GeneratorAction,
    MagneticField,
    enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo,
    addParametersToRunHeader,
    _configureDD4HEP,
    setupTrackingField,
    setupUserPhysics,
    _kernel_terminate,
    run,
    commandsPreRun,
    commandsPostRun,
    commandsInitialize,

    kernel,

)
from dd4hep import Detector

def display_help():
    help_text = """
    DD4hep Simulation Help

    Usage:
      python simulation.py [options]

    Options:
      -h, --help            Show this help message and exit
      -g, --geometry FILE   Specify geometry XML file
      -n, --nevents N       Number of events to simulate
      -v, --visualize       Enable visualization
      --seed SEED           Set random seed
      --output FILE         Output file name
      --field FILE          Magnetic field configuration file
      --physics PHYSICS     Physics list to use
    """
    print(help_text)

def main():
    # Setup logger
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
    logger = logging.getLogger("DD4hepSimulation")

    # Parse command line arguments
    cmd = CommandLine()
    cmd.add_option("-h", "--help", action="store_true", dest="help", default=False)
    cmd.add_option("-g", "--geometry", type=str, dest="geometry", default="detector.xml")
    cmd.add_option("-n", "--nevents", type=int, dest="nevents", default=10)
    cmd.add_option("-v", "--visualize", action="store_true", dest="visualize", default=False)
    cmd.add_option("--seed", type=int, dest="seed", default=None)
    cmd.add_option("--output", type=str, dest="output", default="output.root")
    cmd.add_option("--field", type=str, dest="field", default=None)
    cmd.add_option("--physics", type=str, dest="physics", default="FTFP_BERT")
    args = cmd.parse_args()

    if args.help:
        display_help()
        sys.exit(0)

    # Setup DD4hep simulation
    sim = DD4hepSimulation()
    logger.info("Loading geometry: %s", args.geometry)
    detector = Detector.getInstance()
    detector.fromXML(args.geometry)

    # Configure DD4hep kernel
    _configureDD4HEP(sim, detector)

    # Setup magnetic field
    if args.field:
        logger.info("Configuring magnetic field from: %s", args.field)
        field = MagneticField(args.field)
        setupTrackingField(sim, field)
    else:
        logger.info("No magnetic field configuration provided.")

    # Setup random generator
    if args.seed is not None:
        logger.info("Setting random seed: %d", args.seed)
        sim.random.setSeed(args.seed)

    # Setup event actions, I/O, and generator actions
    logger.info("Setting up event actions and I/O")
    sim.output = args.output
    sim.event_actions = []
    sim.generator_actions = []
    sim.generator_actions.append(GeneratorAction("PrimaryGeneratorAction"))
    sim.mapActions()

    # Enable detailed hits and particle info
    enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo(sim)

    # Setup detectors
    logger.info("Setting up detectors")
    sim.setupDetectors(detector)

    # Build physics list
    logger.info("Building physics list: %s", args.physics)
    setupUserPhysics(sim, args.physics)

    # Add special particle types and global range cut
    logger.info("Adding special particle types and setting global range cut")
    sim.addSpecialParticles()
    sim.setGlobalRangeCut(1.0)  # 1 mm

    # Add parameters to run header
    addParametersToRunHeader(sim)

    # Pre-run commands
    commandsPreRun(sim)

    # Visualization

        logger.info("Visualization enabled")
        sim.ui.addCommand("/vis/open OGL")
        sim.ui.addCommand("/vis/drawVolume")
        sim.ui.addCommand("/vis/viewer/set/viewpointThetaPhi 90 0")
